subject.title: feat(ui): add reactive OpenClaw health nudges

question: Should OpenClaw ship this UI-only, proactive health-nudge behavior on the permanent custodian page now, rather than keeping the page passive pending the broader cancellable server-side diagnosis follow-up?
rationale: The patch creates a new operator-facing intervention model and the supplied context describes the server-side companion as deliberately deferred; code review cannot determine whether the UI-only phase is the intended permanent product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the scoped UI phase
options.body: Accept one dismissible, consequential-health nudge per visit after the credential-coverage defect and real-behavior-proof gap are resolved.

options.title: Defer proactive nudges
options.body: Keep the custodian page passive until the cancellable server-side diagnosis and command-routing design is approved and delivered.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the scoped UI phase
recommendation.body: Accept one dismissible, consequential-health nudge per visit after the credential-coverage defect and real-behavior-proof gap are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch and phase proposal provide the only concrete ownership signal in the supplied review context.
